now.title: The Punisher S2#5
now.text: Curtis Hoyle gives Amy and Frank a campervan to hide in while John Pilgrim hunts her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's friend, who gives Amy and Frank a campervan to hide in.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A girl Curtis hides in a campervan.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#8
proposed.text: Curtis Hoyle stands up for Amy when Frank nearly shoots her in the campervan Curtis lent them, then stays with her and tells her Frank cares about her.

changes.evidence: Amy and Curtis are first on screen together in S2#8 (My Brother's Keeper): Curtis arrives at the campervan with Frank, stops Frank berating her, then returns that night, they introduce themselves and eat spaghetti while he tells her Frank cares about her. In S2#5 Frank only tells Amy that Curtis has a place they can stay; Curtis is not with her.

now.title: The Punisher S2#7
now.text: Before going after Billy Russo, Frank asks Curtis to take care of Amy and take her to Madani if anything happens to him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Frank's friend, who looks after Amy for Frank.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A girl Curtis hides in a campervan, and looks after for Frank.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#9
proposed.text: Curtis looks after Amy in the campervan while Frank hunts Billy Russo, and they talk about her dream of marine salvage.

changes.evidence: Frank's request to 'take care of the kid' is made to Curtis alone in the car in S2#7 (One Bad Day); Amy is not there and they have not met yet. Curtis actually looks after Amy in the campervan in S2#9 (Flustercluck), tracking Russo's crew on the radio with her and hearing her marine salvage dream. Current card lines stay true.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
proposed.text: Kim leads the police detail guarding Matt and Kirsten as they leave Karen's trial, and fights back when the AVTF ambushes them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An ally whose resistance Angie stands with, and whom she guards at Karen's trial.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An honest detective who stands with Matt's resistance and guards him at Karen's trial.

changes.evidence: In S2#7 (The Hateful Darkness), after the first day of Karen's trial, Kim leads the protective detail taking Murdock and McDuffie to the parking lot; the AVTF ambushes them, Kim and Cherry fight back and Kim drives McDuffie to safety. Their only stage (S1#9) has Kim merely present when Daredevil enters Josie's.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
proposed.text: When Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. seizes the Playground, Weaver meets Fitz again and tells him Coulson has no right to call his group S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Weaver's former student, now on Coulson's side against her faction.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's teacher at the Academy, now with the faction that seizes his base.

changes.evidence: In S2#15 (One Door Closes) Gonzales' faction takes over the Playground; Weaver speaks to Fitz and Simmons, who are surprised she is alive, and says Coulson has no right to call his organization S.H.I.E.L.D. In S2#16 Fitz refuses to help Gonzales and leaves. Their only stage is S1#12.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
now.text: May joins Anne Weaver on Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. council. Weaver presses her for answers about Coulson's secret Theta Protocol, but May gives away very little.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow council member who gives away very little.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow council member who presses May about Theta.

changes.evidence: Gonzales only asks May to join the board at the end of S2#16 (Afterlife), where Weaver is mentioned but not on screen. The control-room scene where Weaver presses May about Deathlok and the Theta Protocol is in S2#17 (Melinda), whose cast includes Weaver.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#8
proposed.text: Trip is shot during the raid in Australia, and Fitz helps keep him alive on Calvin Zabo's instructions.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps save Trip's life.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend of Fitz's, whose life Fitz helps save.

changes.evidence: In S2#8 (The Things We Bury) Trip, Coulson and Fitz enter the Laura Creek station; Trip is badly shot, Calvin Zabo severs a vein while stitching him and then shows Fitz and Coulson how to save him.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#18
now.text: Antoine Triplett joins Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls and fights beside May on mission after mission.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate whose piloting orders Trip follows to the letter.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who follows May's piloting orders to the letter.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Trip fights beside on mission after mission.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who fights beside May on mission after mission.

changes.evidence: Both card lines describe Trip following May's piloting orders to the letter, which happens in S2#10 (What They Become), when he and May shake off four Hydra Quinjets in the Bus. The stage is S1#18.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
proposed.text: Trip follows May's instructions to the letter as the two shake off four Hydra Quinjets in the Bus.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate whose piloting orders Trip follows to the letter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who follows May's piloting orders to the letter.

changes.evidence: In S2#10 Trip and May combine their piloting to evade four Hydra Quinjets as the Bus cloaks, Trip following her instructions to the letter. This stage carries the card lines moved off the S1#18 stage.

now.title: The Defenders#5
now.text: Bakuto doubts Daredevil is a real threat when Murakami warns the Hand about him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A threat Bakuto doubts when Murakami warns of him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A Hand founder who doubts Daredevil is a threat.

changes.evidence: In The Defenders#5 Bakuto only hears Murakami warn the Hand about Daredevil and doubts he is a threat; Matt is not there. Knowing about someone is not an event between them. They first meet in The Defenders#7, the next stage.

now.title: Iron Fist S1#12
now.text: Ward makes a deal with Bakuto's faction of the Hand, but the alliance falls apart.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A businessman whose deal with Bakuto falls apart.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Hand leader Ward makes a failed deal with.

changes.evidence: In Iron Fist S1#12 the deal turns into betrayal in the same episode: Bakuto takes Ward, Joy and Harold hostage at the penthouse, strikes Ward, has the bodyguards executed, shoots Joy and tells Ward he will not keep his end of the deal. Bakuto dies the same episode, so the title leaves them enemies, not allies.

now.title: Iron Fist S2#8
now.text: BB turns on Davos and helps Joy steal the bowl that can take back the Iron Fist.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Iron Fist BB helps against Davos.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A gang kid who turns on Davos and helps steal his bowl.

changes.evidence: In Iron Fist S2#8 BB helps Joy steal Davos's bowl; Danny is not involved, so nothing happens between BB and Danny. BB brings the bowl to Danny and Colleen in S2#9, the next stage.

now.title: Iron Fist S2#8
now.text: Davos trains BB and the other Ryhno gang members in martial arts. BB turns on him and helps Joy steal his bowl.
now.on_a_card_about_b: BB's trainer. BB turns on him and helps Joy steal his bowl.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A gang kid Davos trains, who turns on him and helps Joy steal his bowl.

changes.evidence: In Iron Fist S2#8 BB turns on Davos: he tries to turn in Chen Wu, fakes being sick, is locked in the cellar, and steals Davos's bowl for Joy so the Iron Fist can be taken back. He never returns to Davos and is killed by Davos's gang in S2#9, so the title leaves them enemies.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#7
proposed.text: Daniel summons BB to Fisk's office and pressures her to credit the AVTF for stopping Muse, warning that refusing will ruin her life.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: BB's inside source at City Hall, who threatens her over her Daredevil story.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist Daniel falls for, and pressures over her Daredevil story.

changes.evidence: In S1#7 (Art for Art's Sake) Blake, sitting in Fisk's chair, reminds BB she burned him with the CleanGreen story and tells her to credit the AVTF instead of Daredevil, implying her life will be ruined if she refuses. In S1#8 he admits he pushed her too hard and they reconcile.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#6
proposed.text: BB nearly kisses Daniel, but he confronts her about the leaks she has been making against Fisk.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: BB's friend, who learns she has been leaking against Fisk.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Daniel's friend, whom he confronts over her leaks.

changes.evidence: In S2#6 (Requiem), after Cashman tells Blake to feed BB false information, BB decides not to leak it and almost kisses Blake, but he confronts her about the previous leaks. In S2#7 he holds her captive before letting her escape.
